'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Mike Tomashewski LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Tomashewski]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Infiltration / Unlikely Allies|VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Shewshi
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
